cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: The Pattern
cards.instruction: Treat every minor detail as evidence of a much larger problem.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. A confession this quick suggests training.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then they're recruiting through hunger. This goes higher than the biscuit tin.
